discordPostHtml:
Tactical Combat Overhaul v0.30.0 (pre-release)

A combat overhaul that turns battles into tactical fleet engagements. Command your fleet like an RTS, or jump into any ship and fly it yourself.

Command

  • RTS controls: box select, orders, formations, control groups, attack-move
  • Stances: Aggressive, Defensive, Hold ground, Evasive and Rescue
  • Fog of war, larger battlefields, and two new objectives: the Supply FOB and the Repair Dock

Combat

  • Armor penetration, ricochets, sloped plates, cook-offs and fires
  • Ballistic guns have limited ammo, refilled mid-battle by supply ships
  • Reactor power alongside flux, and meltdowns from deep hits
  • Ships burn and break up while their crew escape in pods

Missiles and sensors

  • Radar missiles need a track to launch; IR missiles chase heat and can be fooled by flares
  • Datalinks, ECM and noise jamming, plus a radar scope when you fly a ship

Boarding

  • Send marines to take ships in deck by deck combat
  • Orders (Assault, Methodical, Sabotage, Withdraw), marine experience, desperate measures taken by defenders.

Logistics

  • Repair tenders, tugs that tow stranded ships, security droids and new hullmods
  • NPC fleets bring their own support ships and use TCO's hullmods too

Built to work with ship and weapon mods: their ships, weapons and missiles fit TCO's rules automatically.

Requires: Starsector 0.98a-RC8. Recommended: LunaLib (in-game settings, where every major system can be tuned or turned off).

Download: https://github.com/reaperyeah420-cpu/Tactical-Combat-Overhaul

Please report issues here and attach starsector.log (in starsector-core) for crashes. Removing TCO from an ongoing save isn't supported.
